clue.text: Heard harsh argument about king's scholarly assignment

indicators.note: heard tells us the word for harsh is only to be taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: harsh means coarse

indicators.note: about here means the word for argument is turned round

parts.note: a row is an argument
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Someone overhears a bitter quarrel over a king's academic task.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heard' turns COARSE into the sound-alike COURSE; ROW turned 'about' gives WOR, and K for king finishes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Coursework is the work a student is set and assessed on during a course of study.

clue.text: Place to eat starters of cornbread and free-range eggs

indicators.note: starters, punning on the first course of a meal, means the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A menu of cornbread and free-range eggs as a first course.
explanation.definitionFit: A cafe is a small restaurant serving simple meals and drinks.

clue.text: Card game modelled after patience originally having no competitors

indicators.note: after means the word for modelled comes after the P

parts.note: Uno is a card game

indicators.note: originally picks the opening letter of patience

parts.note: its first letter is P
posed means modelled, as for an artist

explanation.surface: A solitaire card game played alone has no rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: Patience is the British name for solitaire, which looks like the definition but supplies only its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unopposed faces no opposition, such as a candidate standing without rivals.

clue.text: Sudden movement scared youngster

parts.note: a spring is a sudden leap
chicken means cowardly, scared

explanation.surface: A child jumps in fright at something abrupt.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring chicken is an idiom for a young person, mostly used in 'no spring chicken'.

clue.text: Bird's woeful cry going round Margate occasionally

indicators.note: going round means the cry surrounds the selected letters

parts.note: a wail is a woeful cry

indicators.note: occasionally means taking every other letter

parts.note: the even letters of Margate give AGT

explanation.surface: A bird's mournful call heard around the seaside town of Margate.
explanation.walkthrough: Margate is an English seaside resort in Kent; its 2nd, 4th and 6th letters go inside WAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A wagtail is a small slender songbird that constantly wags its long tail.

clue.text: Sorting hierarchical positions of soldiers, knight and monarch

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers
N is the chess notation for knight
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Arranging the order of rank among troops, a knight and a king.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like chess pieces in a ladder; the soldiers are the Royal Artillery and the knight is N in chess notation.
explanation.definitionFit: Ranking is the act of placing things in order of status or standing.

clue.text: Flee south with queen, perhaps

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
a queen is a female cat, so a cat is an example signalled by perhaps

explanation.surface: An instruction to run off southwards accompanied by a monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: A queen is the breeders' term for a female cat, which the surface hides behind royalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Scat is an informal command or verb meaning to run away quickly.

clue.text: Reportedly, London gangsters rage

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said aloud, a sound-alike

parts.note: the Krays were the twin gangsters Ronnie and Reggie Kray, who ran London's East End in the 1960s

explanation.surface: News reports say London criminals are furious.
explanation.walkthrough: The Kray twins were notorious East End London gangsters of the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: A rage is a fad, a widespread enthusiasm, as in 'all the rage'.

clue.text: Become fond of job making carpet

parts.note: to take to someone is to become fond of them
a task is a job

explanation.surface: Someone grows to like a job laying floor coverings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carpet' is the verb, as in being carpeted by the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is British informal for reprimanding them, as being called on the carpet.

clue.text: Surface of loo roll absorbs

indicators.note: absorbs means the phrase before it soaks up and holds the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A household observation about how toilet paper soaks things up.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits across the words 'of loo roll', starting with the last letter of 'of'.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor is the lower surface of a room that people walk on.

clue.text: Crew prepare before last of folk board on ship

indicators.note: before places the earlier pieces ahead of the final letter

parts.note: a gang is a crew of workers
to plan is to prepare

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of folk

parts.note: its final letter is K

explanation.surface: A ship's crew gets ready before the last passengers come aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangplank is a movable plank used as a walkway for boarding or leaving a vessel.

clue.text: Prior needs queries to be resolved with priest

indicators.note: to be resolved means to be broken down and resettled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A monastic prior needs his questions answered, along with a priest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior' looks like the head of a priory, but it means earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Prerequisites are things required beforehand, conditions that must be met first.

clue.text: One following joke with poke of tongue

indicators.note: following means the numeral one comes after the other pieces

parts.note: a pun is a joke on words
a jab is a poke
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone sticks their tongue out after cracking a joke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tongue' looks like the body part being poked out, but it means a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Punjabi is a language spoken in Punjab, across India and Pakistan; tongue is a synonym for language.

clue.text: Number exposed affair

indicators.note: exposed means stripped of its outer layer, so the first and last letters go

parts.note: seventy is a number

explanation.surface: A numbered scandal being revealed to the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is not EVEN but SEVENTY, which loses its ends when 'exposed'.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is an occurrence or happening, and affair has that general sense too.

clue.text: Agent before noon on road travelling to collect fish

indicators.note: to collect means the other pieces gather the fish inside them
in a down clue on means placed above, so AM comes first

parts.note: AM means ante meridiem, before noon

indicators.note: travelling means moving about, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a bass is a fish

explanation.surface: A representative sets off on the road in the morning to pick up some fish.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means sitting above, so the morning abbreviation comes first; the fish is then gathered in straight after it.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador is an official envoy acting for their country abroad.

clue.text: Pleasant-sounding American entering phoney claim

indicators.note: entering means the American piece goes inside the reworked letters
phoney means fake, so the letters of claim are rearranged

explanation.surface: An American making a fraudulent claim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pleasant-sounding' may suggest a homophone, but it is simply the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical describes something melodious, agreeable to the ear.

clue.text: Regularly ignored show in French you reviewed is broadcast

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, here the even-placed ones of the two words
reviewed is read as re-viewed, looked at the other way, so the French word runs backwards

parts.note: tu is the familiar French for you

explanation.surface: A show that is regularly ignored goes out anyway, reviewed in French.
explanation.walkthrough: Every second letter of IGNORED SHOW gives GOESO; TU reversed adds UT.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that goes out is transmitted, the idiom for being on air.

clue.text: Speak about current surgical speciality position

indicators.note: about means the word for speak goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally
I is the physics symbol for electric current
ENT is ear, nose and throat, a surgical specialism

explanation.surface: A lecturer talks about the state of the art in surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: To orientate something is to place it in a particular direction or alignment.

clue.text: It's confusing how to make duck smaller yet bigger

parts.note: to make bigger is to increase, a verb for summing more on
the diminutive suffix that turns a duck into a duckling, its young

explanation.surface: A riddle about shrinking a duck while making it larger.
explanation.walkthrough: The suffix that makes duck into duckling shrinks the bird; adding letters also makes the word bigger, so the instruction 'add ling' is the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Addling means muddling or confusing someone's mind, so something addling is confusing.

clue.text: Trash receptacle seen in Parisian station?

indicators.note: seen in means the container is placed inside the station

parts.note: gare is French for railway station
a bag is a receptacle

explanation.surface: A rubbish bin spotted at a Paris railway station.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is waste or rubbish, the American word for refuse.

clue.text: Relatives firm with us about moral offence

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: about means the word us goes round the offence

parts.note: a sin is a moral offence

explanation.surface: Family members are cross with us over some wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Cousins are kin, the children of one's aunts or uncles.

clue.text: Hollowed out chunky squash plant

indicators.note: hollowed out means the inside is emptied, leaving only the first and last letters

parts.note: chunky with its middle removed leaves CY
to press is to squash

explanation.surface: A recipe step: scoop out a thick gourd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squash' looks like the vegetable and 'plant' fits it, but squash is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A cypress is an evergreen coniferous tree, a kind of plant.

clue.text: Declined eating hot piece of meat

indicators.note: eating means the word for declined swallows the abbreviation

parts.note: sank means declined, went down
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone turned down a hot cut of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Shank is a cut of meat from the lower leg of an animal.

clue.text: First to leave ship lane

indicators.note: first to leave means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: a galley is a ship

explanation.surface: The first passenger disembarks onto a narrow path.
explanation.definitionFit: An alley is a narrow passage or lane between buildings.

clue.text: Second of pirates person at sea enlists

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are rearranged
second of picks the second letter of pirates

parts.note: its second letter is I

explanation.surface: Pirates recruiting someone on board a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' looks like part of the pirate scene, but it shuffles PERSON with the I from pirates.
explanation.definitionFit: To rope someone in is to persuade them to take part, to recruit or sign them up.

clue.text: Iron edges of light fabric

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

indicators.note: edges of picks the first and last letters

parts.note: its outer letters are L and T

explanation.surface: Pressing the borders of a lightweight cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Felt is a cloth made of matted, compressed wool fibres.

clue.text: Outline tale I need to adapt

indicators.note: to adapt means to change, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A storyteller needs to rework a story.
explanation.definitionFit: To delineate is to describe or trace the outline of something precisely.

clue.text: Run revolutionary European business

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the word for run is read backwards

parts.note: to dart is to run quickly

explanation.surface: A radical European operates a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Trade means commerce, the business of buying and selling.

clue.text: Fish breed, we're told

indicators.note: we're told means this is what is heard, a sound-alike

parts.note: to raise animals is to breed them

explanation.surface: Someone reports that fish reproduce.
explanation.definitionFit: Rays are flat cartilaginous sea creatures with wide wing-like fins.

clue.text: A nun that's abridged religious work is diligent

parts.note: per means a, as in once a day

indicators.note: abridged means shortened, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a sister is a nun
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A nun who shortens a holy text is hardworking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A' means each, as in 'ten pounds a head', which the Latin-derived word also means.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistent describes someone who keeps going steadily, sticking at a task.
